title: Evaluate ligature context controls on independent works with internal morphological matches
statement: The P-L1-018 embedded implementation and SHA-verified LLCT files reproduce every stored calibration and held-apart row, summary, threshold and standalone-letter outcome. The reconstructed plan JSON has a different byte hash, so this is numerical reproduction rather than an exact-byte replay of the original plan or calibration artifact. The five us/um repeats contain 657–658 matched pairs, with only 31–32 unequal right contexts; all 626 terminal pairs tie. The ten standalone-letter tests accepted 7, 6 and 2 cases under unconditioned, position-all and position-info thresholds respectively. For a further exploratory source, the pinned UD Latin ITTB train file contains Aquinas Summa contra gentiles books II–IV. Using the original morphology/left matching and seed 66103, those individual books have respectively 28, 90 and 104 internal same-morphology pairs; books III and IV meet the frozen 40-site minimum. Applying the LLCT-frozen thresholds to each book after examining support, five pairing seeds per book give: position-aware scores rank the planted internal target before the paired alternative in all ten eligible runs, but both candidates fail both position-aware absolute thresholds in all ten. Unconditioned scoring ranks the alternative ahead in all ten and also accepts neither. The terminal same-stem/case arm ties in all fifteen book/seed runs; both position-aware methods accept both candidates in every tie. The standalone-letter acceptance counts in books II, III and IV are 7/10, 7/10, 7/10 unconditioned; 3/10, 4/10, 4/10 position-all; and 1/10 in each position-info. These three books share an author and work, and pairing seeds reuse the text. The exploratory source and matching were chosen after prior results and do not constitute independent manuscripts or confirmatory replication.
check: Obtain independently authored, openly reusable annotated Latin works with at least 40 disjoint internal matched pairs per work, verify underlying work boundaries and genre, and lock candidate construction before scoring. Validate annotation and external contexts on matched source spans, evaluate the frozen thresholds and standalone-letter negatives once per work, and report both pairwise ordering and absolute acceptance. Compare genuine and wrong alternatives without counting pairing seeds as independent samples. Keep the original ambiguous published loss distinguished from the later context-based scores and do not infer graphical ligatures from statistical ranks alone.

methods.prior_replay: Download three LLCT pinned files from URLs and validate hashes embedded in experiments/P-L1-018/mubadala777/step.json, reconstruct plan from evidence.design with indent=2, extract its embedded Python scripts, run calibration and evaluation. Compared every row, threshold, summary and negative-control list to stored JSON. The byte-level plan and consequent calibration hash differ because serialization is reconstructed.
methods.external_source: UD Latin ITTB https://github.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_Latin-ITTB/tree/16cc97fce6969cdec628544c57194938281fbcdf, train file SHA256 7a8ed5d4a3391e918213ffa988f0930364e009e97a4ae4c3c820837fb3cfe29a. README states CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; only derived aggregate results are submitted. Book II uses train sentence indices 105–5657, III 5658–13519 and IV 16810–22775, per repository README. These are parts of a single work; corpus carries no compatible charter document IDs.
methods.selection: Check internal support first, then run original five pairing seeds and frozen LLCT calibration. No thresholds refit. Exact exterior contexts and morphology are as the original parser and matcher define. Counts below 40 abstain.
methods.limits: Post-support analysis, no new manuscript data, same-author parts of a single work, annotated text not independent of linguistic modeling, no proof of visual ligature. Different corpus sizes and genre may affect transfer. Single control alphabet and only ten operational standalone-letter tests per book.

reproduction.instruction: Extract the scripts and design from P-L1-018/mubadala777/step.json evidence.reproduction, download its pinned files and calibrate/evaluate as described there; write evidence.design to plan.json. Download the ITTB train and test files at the listed commit and SHA-verify them. Run support, book segmentation and scoring scripts in that directory with PYTHONPATH including the original repository and script directory. book_score expects the segmented book files produced by the segmentation procedure; these can be generated by retaining the same ranges in book_support.py outside its temporary directory.
reproduction.book_score_script:
import json, pathlib
import charter_context as c
from charter_context import run_rows,summarized,negative_controls
thresholds=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/voy-llct/calibration.json').read_text())['thresholds'];out={}
for n in (2,3,4):
 p=pathlib.Path('/tmp/voy-llct/corpus')/('book'+str(n)+'.conllu');p.write_bytes(pathlib.Path('/tmp/voy-llct/book'+str(n)+'.conllu').read_bytes());words,info=c.read_words('book'+str(n));rows=run_rows(words,[('us','um')],('internal','internal_same_morph','terminal_same_stem_case'),set());neg=negative_controls(words,thresholds);out[str(n)]={'source':info,'summary':summarized(rows,thresholds),'rows':rows,'negative_acceptances':{m:sum(x['acceptances'][m] for x in neg) for m in c.METHODS}};print(n,json.dumps(out[str(n)]['summary']),flush=True)
pathlib.Path('/tmp/voy-llct/book-score.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
